newsitem.title: USA: Interactive Medical sees Q3 profitability.
newsitem.headline: Interactive Medical sees Q3 profitability.

text.p: Interactive Medical Technologies Ltd said Wednesday that it will reach profitability during the third calendar quarter of this year for the first time in its 10-year operating history.

Interactive said that during the period from April 14 to May 25, 1997, its network marketing subsidiary set record sales during its first 45 days of full commercial operations while increasing its distributor base over 220 percent.

The stronger than expected sales revenue and the 220 percent increase in new distributors are the result of simple, duplicable, distributor programs combined with the company's strong marketing support of the flagship "Royal Hawaiian NONI" product which was introduced to the network marketing industry on April 14, the company said.
